facts.text: All first-year students at UW Bothell must complete the Discovery Core Experience (DCX), a required interdisciplinary course sequence that explores connections across distinct academic fields while supporting transition into college.

sources.title: About - First Year & Pre-Major Program
sources.quote: The Discovery Core (DCX)—a required sequence of courses for first-year students—will strengthen your capacity for active learning, critical and creative inquiry, engagement with diverse perspectives, quantitative reasoning, writing, interdisciplinary thinking, and communication across multiple media platforms.
